title: One pruning round
notes: low ×5, lowest ×2, newer ×6, wider ×3, new ×2, with a seed of 12 longer pieces. newer is the most expensive to lose (15.69: newer ×6 becomes new er), and eight pieces cost nothing. The round keeps 9 of the 12 and removes ewe, ewer and newe, the rarest of the free ones.
